messages:
IncidentBot: [INC-2534] Pager cleared — KV eviction surge resolved. Severity: Sev3. Mitigation applied by Maya. Summary: autoscaler back to normal; eviction rate dropped from 12% -> 0.3%. Incident link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2534
Maya: quick notes — used emergency throttle on batch writer and rolled back recent config change. customers impacted briefly, mostly elevated latencies on embeddings pipeline.
Jon: thx. can we schedule postmortem + runbook sweep? my Tues/Thu open.
Sophie: prefer Wed 10:00 UTC. we need numbers: how many Dedicated customers saw >1s latency increase? support ticket count?
Maya: I ran a quick query, looks like 4 customers had alerts, 2 had active SE involvement. will post details to doc.
Anya: I can update runbook section `kv-hotkey-eviction` — add step to check `top_keys` and a script to pin heavy prefixes. sharing snippet:
```
# quick check
redis-cli --bigkeys
python tools/check_kv_hotkeys.py --threshold 1000
```
Maya: perfect. also let's add an on-call handoff checklist item: verify eviction counters <0.5% before signing off.
Product Ops: putting meeting on calendar for Wed 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC, invite sent to eng-oncall, eng-sre, product and support.
Jon: created postmortem doc -> https://docs.redwood/postmortems/INC-2534 - added sections: timeline, customer-impact, mitigations, root-cause hypothesis, action items.
Sophie: action items — Sophie: quantify customer impact (tickets + perf delta) by Fri; Anya: update runbook and add code snippet by Thu; Jon: finalize postmortem narrative by Mon; Maya: update on-call playbook and add 'eviction throttle' step by Thu.
Maya: I'll also add a small training blurb into on-call rotation deck.
Jon: assigning Jira: RW-4321 (postmortem writeup), RW-4322 (runbook edits), RW-4323 (customer outreach)
Sophie: can product ops own customer comms? cc @Product Ops
Product Ops: yeah we'll draft comms after postmortem review.
Maya: small followup: add metric to alerting — `kv_eviction_rate > 1% for 5m` -> alert higher priority, and new dashboard panel.
Anya: I'll open PR for runbook changes and add tests for the `check_kv_hotkeys` script.
Jon: thanks everyone. let's aim to close action items within 2 sprints.
Maya: noted. closing loop — will run a tabletop in next oncall rotation to practice handoff.
Sophie: :thumbsup: 
Jon: :white_check_mark: 
IncidentBot: Postmortem scheduled and reminders set. Closing thread.
